title: Double-Sided Printing
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

You are given a positive integer $N$.

You will print a document consisting of $N$ pages on sheets of copy paper.

You will use double-sided printing, so one page can be printed on each of the front and back of a sheet.

Find the minimum number of sheets of copy paper needed to print all $N$ pages.

## Constraints

- $1\le N\le 100$
- $N$ is an integer.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
```

## Output

Print the answer.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

给定一个正整数 $N$。

你需要将一份由 $N$ 页组成的文档打印在复印纸上。

你将使用双面打印，因此每张纸的正面和背面各可以打印一页。

求打印全部 $N$ 页所需的最少复印纸张数。

## 约束条件

- $1\le N\le 100$
- $N$ 是整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
N
```

## 输出格式

输出答案。

samples.note: By printing on both sides of one sheet of copy paper and on one side of another, you can print $3$ pages using $2$ sheets.
